name: Firewall status (Linux)
description: What this host is actually filtering, via ufw, firewalld, nftables or iptables. Linux only.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Firewall status (Linux)
snippets.description: Read-only: reports the active ruleset and changes nothing.

steps.content:
# Read-only: reports the rules, changes nothing.
if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo ufw status verbose
elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo firewall-cmd --list-all
elif command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo nft list ruleset | grep -q .; then
  sudo nft list ruleset
elif command -v iptables >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo iptables -L -n -v
else
  echo "no firewall tool found (ufw, firewalld, nftables, iptables)"
fi
